box-physics/outpost-pulse.title: Outpost Pulse
box-physics/outpost-pulse.about: Outpost crate puzzles: urgent industrial motion without losing space to think. A faster low detuned bass and heavier machinery beat drive the climb; dark pads, sharp telemetry, brass stabs, and a rising pulse motif build tension. Original dramatic science-fiction cue in E phrygian.

fighter/afterburner.title: Afterburner
fighter/afterburner.about: Fighter Plane sortie music: synthwave at speed. The base layer is cruise (drums, pumping bass, pad, arp). The combat layer adds the lead, stabs and extra percussion; fade it in when bandits are up.

shared/defeat.title: Defeat
shared/defeat.about: The run is over: low strings fall through a minor line and stop on a dark chord with one deep hit. It is meant to be dull: the report will say there is no air above 6 kHz. One shot; play it with music.stinger().

shared/victory.title: Victory
shared/victory.about: A level is won: a four-bar brass fanfare that lands on a held major chord. One shot; play it with music.stinger().

soccer/kickoff.title: Kickoff
soccer/kickoff.about: Soccer Player, a match in a 1990s sports anime: bright rock at full speed. Overdriven power chords and a picked bass drive it, a trumpet plays the tune like a theme song, brass punches the off-beats, and the bridge drops to half time before the last chorus.

soccer/spotlight.title: Spotlight
soccer/spotlight.about: Penalty Showdown, one kick at a time under the stadium lights: suspenseful but bright enough for a child. A heartbeat kick and picked bass make room for the shot, while clipped guitar and a short trumpet hook answer with a sports-anime lift. A clutch layer adds toms and brass in sudden death.

tank/iron-road.title: Iron Road
tank/iron-road.about: Main drive theme for Nuclear Tank: a march that rolls. Low strings saw away under a horn tune, brass punches the bar lines.

tankterrain/open-country.title: Open Country
tankterrain/open-country.about: Tank Terrain, the drive across open country to the fort: broad and determined, a war film more than an arcade. A marching snare and a low drum under bowed strings, a French horn theme with room to breathe, a choir behind it, and a trumpet that joins for the last pass.
